items.title: Dave S. Oxley Sr. Interview, 1965-01-06
items.q: And I kind of had taken some little things that Happy used to do, you know, on the bugle blues... He used to throw his sticks on the floor.

ctx.x: Up on the stage, too. Yeah, on the stage.

And I kind of had taken some little things that Happy used to do, you know, on the bugle blues, you know. What did they do? I never got to see. He used to throw his sticks on the floor. Let them bounce. And bounce up. And on the brakes, he'd pull a string and a pistol would shoot. You know what I mean?
And a wing and all that kind of stuff, you know.
